sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Closer on the plane ≈ more alike in plot, genres, and languages; depth ≈ release date. Larger ≈ more votes (log scale); brighter ≈ higher TMDB average; color ≈ primary genre. Big is not always bright.

sections.heading: Usage
sections.body:
After loading: cover → tap the center globe for The Movie Today (one pick per UTC day).

Drag to orbit. Without Space: scroll wheel or timeline moves you along release-year depth. In macro roam, hold Space and scroll to dolly in; release Space to reset distance. Hover shows a one-line preview.

Search titles, people, or genres in the bar; ESC unwinds search, side sheet, then focus. Click a film for focus and the side sheet; click neighbors to switch.

sections.heading: Data & device
sections.body:
Film facts come from TMDB (The Movie Database). The Movie Cosmos is not an official TMDB product. We build our offline galaxy from public movie listings (often starting from a free Kaggle snapshot). If you reuse raw data commercially, read TMDB, IMDb, and Kaggle terms yourself. On-screen use follows TMDB credits; legal and third-party notes are in the GitHub repo NOTICE.

Use a recent browser with hardware acceleration. The first visit downloads a large compressed pack—very old browsers or locked-down networks may not open it.

sections.heading: Privacy
sections.body: No sign-in. We may turn on Cloudflare’s simple, mostly cookie-free stats for overall traffic and how fast the site feels—not to identify you or your film picks. Ad or privacy blockers can hide those pings; the galaxy still runs.

scene.webgl2Required: [Scene] WebGL2 is required (`gl_InstanceID`, dual InstancedMesh pipeline). Upgrade the browser or enable hardware acceleration (Phase 7.2 baseline).
